current_point.claim: 提出了一种基于图摘要的大规模时序图表示学习方法GSAERU，通过图摘要技术将动态时序图映射到固定规模的新图，解决了GNN输出无法直接输入RNN训练的问题。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a large-scale sequential graph representation learning method GSAERU based on graph summarization, which maps dynamic sequential graphs to fixed-size new graphs via graph summarization, solving the problem that GNN outputs cannot be directly fed into RNN for training.
technical_features: 将动态时序图建模为各时刻原图快照的序列
在单时间步上通过图摘要技术压缩原图，将压缩后的新图输入图自编码器，利用与原图的重构误差训练原图节点的表征
将单时间步图表征输入循环神经网络学习时间维度上的特征信息与依赖关系
technical_features_en: Modeling dynamic sequential graphs as a sequence of snapshots of the original graph at each time step

Compressing the original graph via graph summarization at a single time step, feeding the compressed new graph into a graph autoencoder, and training node representations using reconstruction error with the original graph
Feeding single-time-step graph representations into a recurrent neural network to learn temporal feature information and dependencies
